					<h1>Learn Africa Scholarship Program 2026 to Study in Spain | Fully Funded</h1>
<p>Applications are now open for the <strong>Learn Africa Scholarship Program 2026</strong>, a fully funded scholarship opportunity for <strong>African women</strong> to pursue postgraduate studies in <strong>Spain</strong>.</p>
<p>The scholarship is offered through selected Spanish universities and supports female students and graduates from African countries with access to quality education in Europe through <strong>face-to-face, online, and blended learning options</strong>.</p>
<p>For selected in-person programs, the scholarship covers <strong>tuition fees, round-trip airfare, accommodation, meals, and health insurance</strong>. Online scholarships cover <strong>tuition fees only</strong>.</p>
<p> </p>
<h2>Learn Africa Scholarship Summary</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Host Country:</strong> Spain</li>
<li><strong>Study Abroad:</strong> Study in Europe</li>
<li><strong>Category:</strong> Postgraduate Scholarships | Master’s Scholarships</li>
<li><strong>Eligible Countries:</strong> African Countries</li>
<li><strong>Reward:</strong> Full Scholarship | Tuition Fees | Airfare | Accommodation | Meals | Health Insurance</li>
<li><strong>Deadline:</strong> April 19, 2026</li>
<li><strong>IELTS:</strong> Not Required</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h2>Learn Africa Scholarship 2026 Details</h2>
<p>The <strong>Learn Africa Scholarship Program</strong> is an initiative by the <strong>Women for Africa Foundation</strong> aimed at empowering African women through access to higher education and professional development opportunities in Spain.</p>
<p>The program allows applicants to choose from different study formats, making it easier for women to apply based on their academic goals and personal circumstances.</p>
<p> </p>
<h2>Eligibility Requirements</h2>
<p>To be considered for the Learn Africa Scholarship Program 2026, applicants must:</p>
<ul>
<li>Be a <strong>woman</strong> from an <strong>African country</strong></li>
<li>Be living in an African country</li>
<li>Be enrolled in an African university or already hold a degree from an African institution</li>
<li>Hold a <strong>Bachelor’s degree</strong> for postgraduate programs</li>
<li>Meet the specific requirements of the chosen scholarship</li>
<li>Meet any language requirements for the selected program</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h2>Scholarship Benefits</h2>
<h3>Face-to-Face Scholarships:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Full tuition fees</li>
<li>Round-trip flight ticket</li>
<li>Accommodation</li>
<li>Meals or monthly allowance</li>
<li>Health insurance</li>
</ul>
<h3>Online Scholarships:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Full tuition fees</li>
</ul>
<h2>Required Documents</h2>
<p>Applicants may be required to submit:</p>
<ul>
<li>Passport or National ID</li>
<li>Passport photograph</li>
<li>CV</li>
<li>Degree certificate or diploma</li>
<li>Academic transcript</li>
<li>Cover letter</li>
<li>Recommendation letter(s)</li>
<li>Proof of language proficiency (if required)</li>
<li>Any additional documents requested by the university</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<h2>How to Apply for Learn Africa Scholarship 2026</h2>
<p>Interested and qualified applicants should:</p>
<ul>
<li>Visit the official scholarship application portal</li>
<li>Select <strong>2026 Learn Africa Scholarships</strong></li>
<li>Create and verify an account</li>
<li>Complete the online application form</li>
<li>Upload all required documents</li>
<li>Review the application carefully before submission</li>
</ul>
<h2><a href="https://mujeresporafrica.es/learn-africa-programa-2026/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">APPLY HERE</a></h2>

<p><strong>Deadline: April 19, 2026</strong></p>
